final: WITH pg AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), a1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg1 FROM pg), k1 AS (SELECT pg.ID, pg.avg_ratio FROM pg CROSS JOIN a1 WHERE a1.avg1 IS NOT NULL AND pg.avg_ratio > a1.avg1), a2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.ID, k1.avg_ratio FROM k1 CROSS JOIN a2 WHERE a2.avg2 IS NOT NULL AND k1.avg_ratio > a2.avg2) SELECT AVG(k2.avg_ratio) AS avg_patient_group_avg, AVG(k2.avg_ratio - a1.avg1) AS avg_diff_first, AVG(k2.avg_ratio - a2.avg2) AS avg_diff_second FROM k2 CROSS JOIN a1 CROSS JOIN a2
